brief: Berlin Pride hit by a deadly terror attack, sparking a manhunt; Trump faces constraints on Iran policy; Europe battles wildfires and drone incidents; UK airport chaos and union strikes dominate domestic news.
news_summary: A car-ramming at Berlin Pride is treated as Islamist terrorism, with police hunting a suspect. Trump hesitates on war escalation amid internal doubts, while Europe grapples with wildfires and a Romanian drone downing.
